formal_and_philosophical_status: Philosophical counterexample argument supported by existing formal proofs; not a new Lean formalization of epistemic justification or of the trilemma.
scope: Existing derivations reused. Selected source excerpts and bibliography accompany the paper; full proof archives are linked by the cited Zenodo records. No fresh Lean verification is claimed.
revision: Direct conclusion and full branch-by-branch argument in section7.11; existing mathematical derivations and38 references retained.
